checks.message: Organizer provisional geometry is retained unchanged and visibly labelled; it supports content review but not official redline claims.
Three provisional key polygons remain unchanged; #1029 location risk is disclosed and no station anchoring is claimed.
Concept land-use bands partition the submitted site without overlap or gap and use allowed codes.
Roads, green space, public space, buildings and phases are clipped to the submitted provisional site.
Core geometry-derived metrics use EPSG:4548 and distinguish reproducibility from official authority.
The visual package is self-contained and loads no remote resources.
Site visit, counts, accessibility audit and stakeholder interviews are not_run; personas and baselines remain hypotheses.
Narrative, matrices, metrics, geometry, figures, PDFs and HTML provide aligned evidence while reserving statutory confirmation.
